en: Changed the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere
zh: 变更任务跟踪工具（TaskCreate/Get/Update/List、TodoWrite）的提供范围，仅在 Claude 3.x、Opus 4.0–4.7、Sonnet 4.0–4.6、Haiku 4.5 上提供；其他情况请设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`
